description: Q-Prime question family for wildcard control-flow patterns. A wildcard match is not a resolved condition and a resolved condition is not authorized execution, so analysis produces questions and gap routes rather than branches.

boundary.note: In AIML, <srai> belongs in a template and redirects text; it is not a control-flow token inside a <pattern>. This family covers an extended wildcard surface and is parsed separately from the AIML loader.

THEN.question: Which condition is true, and must both continuation expressions execute?

ELSE.question: What is the corresponding THEN branch, and what causes ELSE to execute?
ELSE.note: ELSE without a known preceding THEN is incomplete as executable control flow. It is recognised as a question pattern and routed to QUERY_GAP; the missing branch is never invented.

BUT.question: Does BUT introduce a contradiction, exception, or overriding constraint?
BUT.note: BUT is not an alias for ELSE. Until the contrast is resolved, taking a branch would be guessing.

question_dimensions.question: Which wildcard matched which input span?
Are repeated captures references to the same value or independent values?
What expression determines whether the branch is taken?
Does THEN, ELSE, or BUT imply execution, fallback, or contrast?
What target does the recursive redirection resolve to?
Is the resulting branch allowed by XCFE in the current phase?

fold_placement.Pop: match the wildcard production and capture spans
fold_placement.Wo: resolve typed bindings and SRAI targets
fold_placement.Sek: evaluate candidate branch semantics and XCFE legality
fold_placement.Ch'en: verify resolved bindings, conditions and evidence
fold_placement.Xul: return the selected answer or clarification

invariants: W1 a wildcard match is not a resolved condition and not authorized execution
W2 THEN implies consequence, ELSE implies alternative, BUT implies contrast or exception
W3 BUT is never read as ELSE and never synthesizes a THEN branch
W4 ELSE without a known THEN yields QUERY_GAP, never an invented branch
W5 a self-closing <srai/> has no target and yields KNOWLEDGE_GAP
W6 <srai> is its own AST node; it is never folded into the condition operator
W7 this grammar is parsed separately from standard AIML, where <srai> lives in templates
W8 capture slots are numbered in order of appearance, 1-based
W9 the legality question is asked before any branch is proposed
W10 a refused proposed branch yields XCFE_REJECT and the refusal code is preserved
W11 analysis is proposal-only: no record produced here can execute a branch
W12 two patterns' capture masks are compared by XOR; a differing mask measures the encodings, not a conflict between branches

trace.law: a wildcard match is recorded as capture bindings, never as a resolved condition or an authorised branch (W1, W11)

fields.captures: one {slot, value} per capture, numbered 1-based in order of appearance (W8)
fields.match.specificity: the count of literal words in the winning pattern; a ranking input, not evidence
